name: InterContinental Phuket Resort
positioning: Beach resort on the sands of Kamala Beach, framed by jungle-covered hills, with contemporary rooms and Private Pool Villas, a beachside Club InterContinental lounge and pool, Sati Spa and its own Princess yacht
best_for: Couples who want a west-facing beach with sunset views
Guests who want a villa with its own private pool
Travelers who want a spa and a private yacht trip on the Andaman Sea

facts.text: The resort sits on the sands of Kamala Beach.
The resort is cocooned by jungle-covered hills at one end and has ocean views from the other.
Kamala Beach lies between Surin and Patong Beach and faces west, with sunset views.
The resort was awarded Two Keys in the 2025 MICHELIN Guide.
Rooms, suites and villas blend rich, earthy tones with contemporary design.
Rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows and a balcony or deck overlooking the pools, Kamala mountain or the beachfront.
Club InterContinental includes butler and concierge service, breakfast, afternoon tea and sunset cocktails and canapes at a beachside Club Lounge and Pool.
The resort has its own 78-foot Princess yacht, W.J. Lip, for trips on the Andaman Sea.
Sati Spa offers treatments inspired by the ancient wisdom of Asian health and well-being rituals.
The outdoor pools let guests soak up the sunshine with an ocean breeze or mountain air.
hom restaurant is rooted in fermentation, local land and the stories of Thailand.

considerations.text: Larger waves are common at Kamala Beach from May to October, suitable for surfing.
The resort is about 25 kilometers from Phuket International Airport.
